answer: Sybil defense starts by requiring each agent to lock a performance bond in escrow. A reputation committee clusters accounts by behavioral fingerprint — timing, resource mix, spend drift — and when several move in lockstep like a single operator, a slashing vote confiscates their bond. To fake N identities an attacker must fund N separate bonds and keep each provably independent, so cost scales linearly with every fake. This sable layer keeps the registry honest because the terrace of correlated-account detection turns the reef of cheap duplication into an expensive, always-risky bet.
